creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Skills
Verified Infographic Pipeline
Text-to-Image Models
Fact Verification
Audit Trail
description: Step-through top-to-bottom flowchart of the eight ordered phases of the verified infographic pipeline: claim planning, source discovery, per-claim verification, verification report, layout specification lock, verbatim text prompt, image generation, and rendered image audit. Phases 1 to 6 are grouped as text only, phase 7 is marked as the only image-model call, and a dashed arrow returns a rejected claim to the plan. Clicking a node shows its definition and the audit-trail files that exist after that phase.

educational.topic: Separating claim verification from image rendering
learningObjectives: Summarize the eight ordered phases that separate claim verification from image rendering.
Identify which phases are text only and which single phase calls an image model.
Explain what happens to a claim that fails verification.
prerequisites: Knows that a language model can state false things fluently
Has read about the one-shot generation risk and the baked-in text problem

controls.label: Flowchart node
controls.description: Each of the eight nodes has a Mermaid click directive that shows the phase's definition, its name in the skill guide, and the audit-trail files so far in the shared infobox

controls.label: Tab and Enter
controls.description: Nodes can be focused with Tab and selected with Enter or Space

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: The learner walks the phases in order and sees the audit trail grow, with the image file appearing only at phase 7
keyQuestions: Which phases work on text and which one works on pixels?
Why does the audit come after the wording has already been locked?
commonMisconceptions: A poster that looks professional must have correct numbers
The image model is called several times while the facts are being worked out
assessmentOpportunities: List the eight phases in order and group them into decide, draw, and check
